question.text: The sponsor-commitment (skin-in-the-game) requirement for a Cat III AIF is:

answer.text: 2.5% of corpus or INR 5 crore, whichever is lower
5% of corpus or INR 10 crore, whichever is lower
10% of corpus with no absolute cap
Nil — sponsor commitment is voluntary for Cat III

explanation.text: The Logic: The Cat III sponsor/manager must maintain a continuing interest of 5% of the corpus or INR 10 crore, whichever is LOWER. This commitment is itself an investment in the scheme and is higher than the Cat I/II threshold. The Trap: Option A is Cat I/II's rule — the classic Cat I/II vs Cat III swap trap. Option C is overstated; option D is wrong, commitment is mandatory. Note: The workbook (pp. 389-390) specifies the 5%/INR 10 crore (lower of) continuing interest for Cat III sponsors/managers and treats it as an investment in the scheme.
